content.text: 📍Historic Old New Castle, DelawareOne of the oldest cities in America and one of my favorite places in Delaware.Old New Castle is one of the most well-preserved historical districts in the United States.This charming little district is my favorite place to grab a coffee and wander around. Admiring the row houses and architecture from the 1600s, daydreaming about what life was like back then. A lot of people have no idea this historical little city even exists!Founded by Dutch settlers in the 1600s, Old New Castle became a National Landmark in 1967 for its colonial-era historic district.A stroll through this charming little town will transport you back to 18th and 19th century America, when the seeds of a new country were just taking root. Learn about the history of the town every where you go - from the restaurants, gardens, shops & museums.
